localpack-bypass.screen.title: Server resource packs
localpack-bypass.screen.message:
The server sent new or changed resource packs: %s%s.
Press the button to download everything you need at once. The packs are saved and switched on automatically.

If you decline, you will be disconnected from the server.
localpack-bypass.screen.reloadFailed: The game would not switch on %s
localpack-bypass.error.url: the address it gave cannot be downloaded from
localpack-bypass.error.status: the server answered with an error (%s)
localpack-bypass.error.connection: the connection broke before the file was complete
localpack-bypass.error.checksum: the file arrived damaged, so it was thrown away
localpack-bypass.error.disk: the file could not be saved to the packs folder
localpack-bypass.disconnect: You declined to download the server's resource packs
localpack-bypass.update.title: Mod update
localpack-bypass.update.message:
Version %s of Local Resource Pack Cache is available, you have %s.

Download it? The old version is replaced and the game has to be restarted.
localpack-bypass.update.installed: Version %s is installed. Restart the game to use it.
localpack-bypass.update.queued: Version %s is downloaded and verified. The old version is removed when you close the game, then restart.
localpack-bypass.update.queuedManual: Version %s is downloaded and verified, but the old jar could not be replaced automatically. Remove it by hand and move the new jar into mods: %s
localpack-bypass.update.dev: Running from a development environment, updates are disabled.
localpack-bypass.update.failed: The update could not be installed: %s
localpack-bypass.config.title: Local Resource Pack Cache settings
localpack-bypass.config.folder.hint: Leave empty to use the game's own resourcepacks folder
localpack-bypass.config.folder.badPath: That is not a folder path this system can open.
localpack-bypass.config.folder.isFile: That path is a file, not a folder.
localpack-bypass.config.folder.cannotCre: That folder could not be created. Check the path and the permissions.
localpack-bypass.config.folder.notWritab: That folder cannot be written to.
localpack-bypass.config.folder.copied: Packs are kept outside the game's own folder, so each one is also copied into %s before it is switched on.
localpack-bypass.config.rememberServers: Remember servers you said yes to
A server you have already taken packs from is not asked about again. The answer is written into the game's own per-server setting as well, next to the Prompt, Enabled and Disabled options.
localpack-bypass.config.keepEarlier.tool: Packs from other servers stay switched on when a new server sends its own. Turn this off to start each server with only that server's packs.
localpack-bypass.config.batchWait.toolti: How long to wait for the rest of a batch. Servers send all their packs at once, so waiting collects them into one question instead of several.
localpack-bypass.config.timeout.tooltip: How long one download may take before it is given up on and tried again.
localpack-bypass.config.attempts.tooltip: How many times a download that did not work is tried again. A checksum that does not match counts as not working: that is what a half-finished transfer looks like.
localpack-bypass.config.history.tooltip: Records every resource pack a server sends, what happened to it and where it came from. Nothing is sent anywhere: the record is a file on your own computer.
localpack-bypass.config.historyLimit.too: How many entries the record keeps before the oldest are dropped.
localpack-bypass.config.verbose.tooltip: Stores the diagnostic detail as well: addresses, hashes, sizes and how long each download took.
localpack-bypass.packs.title: Downloaded packs
localpack-bypass.packs.empty: No packs have been downloaded yet. This list fills up as you join servers that use them.
localpack-bypass.packs.details.action: Press to switch this pack on or off
localpack-bypass.packs.details.gone: The file is no longer in the folder; press to forget it
localpack-bypass.packs.forgetAll.title: Forget everything?
localpack-bypass.packs.forgetAll.message:
The mod forgets which servers you said yes to, which packs it downloaded, and the record of what servers sent.

No pack files are deleted.
localpack-bypass.history.title: What servers sent
localpack-bypass.history.empty: Nothing yet. Every resource pack a server sends is listed here.
localpack-bypass.history.off: Keeping a record is switched off. Turn it on in the settings to see what servers send.
localpack-bypass.history.count: Showing the last %s entries, newest first
localpack-bypass.history.clear.title: Clear the record?
localpack-bypass.history.clear.message: Every entry is removed. Packs you have downloaded are not touched, and the mod keeps remembering the servers you said yes to.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.localpack: Downloads server resource packs with one button, saves them to resourcepacks and enables them automatically. If a pack is already downloaded, you join without any prompts.
